Confucius said, 'Raise the upright and set them over the crooked, and the crooked will be made straight. Elevate the upright, and the crooked may become good. The unprincipled will withdraw of their own accord. Why bother sorting out factions at all—and risk damaging the cultivation of benevolence? " Supervising remonstrator Wu Anshi and rectifier Liu Anshi memorialized in succession that Chunren was Cai Que's partisan. Chunren also pressed hard to resign.
63
明年，以觀文殿學士知潁昌府。 逾年，加大學士、知太原府。 其境土狹民眾，惜地不葬。 純仁遣僚屬收無主燼骨，別男女異穴，葬者三千餘。 又推之一路，葬以萬數計。 夏人犯境，朝廷欲罪將吏。 純仁自引咎求貶。 秋，有詔貶官一等，徙河南府，再徙潁昌。
The next year he was made Hanlin academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature and prefect of Yingchang. A year later he was made grand academician and prefect of Taiyuan. The territory was cramped and populous; people hoarded land and would not bury their dead. Chunren sent staff to collect unclaimed cremated remains, burying men and women in separate graves—more than three thousand in all. He extended the practice across the circuit; burials numbered in the tens of thousands. When Tanguts raided the border, the court wanted to punish the commanders. Chunren accepted blame and asked to be demoted. That autumn an edict demoted him one rank, sent him to Henan prefecture, then to Yingchang.
64
召還，復拜右僕射。 因入謝，宣仁后簾中諭曰：「或謂卿必先引用王覿、彭汝礪，卿宜與呂大防一心。 」對曰：「此二人實有士望，臣終不敢保位蔽賢，望陛下加察。 」純仁將再入也，楊畏不悅，嘗有言，純仁不知。 至是，大防約畏為助，欲引為諫議大夫。 純仁曰：「諫官當用正人，畏不可用。 」大防曰：「豈以畏嘗言公邪？ 」純仁始知之。 後畏叛大防，凡有以害大防者，無所不至。 宣仁後寢疾，召純仁曰：「卿父仲淹，可謂忠臣。 在明肅皇后垂簾時，唯勸明肅盡母道； 明肅上賓，唯勸仁宗盡子道。 卿當似之。 」純仁泣曰：「敢不盡忠。
Recalled to court, he was again made Right Vice Director. When he came to give thanks, the regent said from behind the curtain, "Some say you will promote Wang Di and Peng Rulü first. You should stand with Lü Dafang as one. " He replied, "Both men truly enjoy scholarly reputation. I would never cling to office and block the worthy. I pray Your Majesty will look into this. " As Chunren was about to return to office, Yang Wei was displeased and had spoken against him—but Chunren did not know. Now Lü Dafang enlisted Yang Wei as an ally and wanted to appoint him Remonstrance Grand Master. Chunren said, "Remonstrance officials must be upright men. Yang Wei is unfit. " Dafang asked, "Is this because Wei once spoke against you? " Only then did Chunren learn of it. Later Yang Wei turned on Lü Dafang and stopped at nothing to destroy him. When the regent fell ill, she summoned Chunren and said, "Your father Zhongyan was a true loyal minister. When Empress Mingsu was regent, he urged her only to fulfill a mother's duty; when she passed away, he urged Renzong only to fulfill a son's duty. You should be like him. " Chunren wept and said, "How could I fail to serve with full loyalty?
65
宣仁后崩，哲宗親政，純仁乞避位。 哲宗語呂大防曰：「純仁有時望，不宜去，可為朕留之。 」且趣入見，問：「先朝行青苗法如何？ 」對曰：「先帝愛民之意本深，但王安石立法過甚，激以賞罰，故官吏急切，以致害民。 」退而上疏，其要以為「青苗非所當行，行之終不免擾民也」。
When Empress Dowager Xuanren died and Zhezong took power himself, Chunren asked to step down. Zhezong told Lü Dafang, "Chunren enjoys great public standing. He should not go. Keep him for me. " He was summoned at once and asked, "What do you think of the green-sprouts policy of the previous reign? " He answered, "The late emperor's care for the people was genuine. But Wang Anshi's laws went too far. Driven by rewards and punishments, officials grew frantic—and the people suffered. " Withdrawing, he memorialized in essence that "the green-sprouts policy should not be pursued; pursued to the end, it will only disturb the people."
66
是時，用二三大臣，皆從中出，侍從、臺諫官，亦多不由進擬。 純仁言：「陛下初親政，四方拭目以觀，天下治亂，實本於此。 舜舉皋陶，湯舉伊尹，不仁者遠。 縱未能如古人，亦須極天下之選。 」又群小力排宣仁后垂簾時事，純仁奏曰：「太皇保佑聖躬，功烈誠心，幽明共監，議者不恤國事，一何薄哉。 」遂以仁宗禁言明肅垂簾事詔書上之。 曰：「望陛下稽仿而行，以戒薄俗。」
At that time the two or three chief ministers were all appointed from within the palace. Attendants and censor-remonstrators too were often chosen without regular nomination. Chunren said, "Your Majesty has just taken power. All the realm watches with clear eyes. Whether the state thrives or fails begins here. Shun raised Gao Yao, Tang raised Yi Yin—and the unprincipled withdrew. Even if Your Majesty cannot match the ancients, choose from the best the realm has to offer. " Petty men meanwhile assailed every policy of the regency. Chunren memorialized, "The Grand Empress Dowager guarded the throne with sincere devotion, witnessed in this world and the next. Critics who ignore the good of the state—how shallow they are! " He submitted Renzong's edict forbidding discussion of Empress Mingsu's regency. He wrote, "I pray Your Majesty will follow that precedent and curb this shallow custom."
67
蘇轍論殿試策問，引漢昭變武帝法度事。 哲宗震怒曰：「安得以漢武比先帝？ 」轍下殿待罪，眾不敢仰視。 純仁從容言：「武帝雄才大略，史無貶辭。 轍以比先帝，非謗也。 陛下親事之始，進退大臣，不當如訶叱奴僕。 」右丞鄧潤甫越次曰：「先帝法度，為司馬光、蘇轍壞盡。 」純仁曰：「不然，法本無弊，弊則當改。 」哲宗曰：「人謂秦皇、漢武。 」純仁曰：「轍所論，事與時也，非人也。 」哲宗為之少霽。 轍平日與純仁多異，至是乃服謝純仁曰：「公佛地位中人也。 」轍竟落職知汝州。
In a palace-examination policy question, Su Zhe cited how Emperor Zhao of Han had altered Emperor Wu's institutions. Zhezong erupted in anger. "How dare you compare Emperor Wu to the late emperor? " Su Zhe stepped down to await punishment. No one in the hall dared look up. Chunren said calmly, "Emperor Wu was a man of heroic vision and great design. History does not condemn him. Su Zhe compared him to the late emperor. That is not slander. At the beginning of Your personal rule, advancing and dismissing great ministers should not be like berating a servant. " Right Vice Director Deng Runfu interrupted: "Sima Guang and Su Zhe have ruined the late emperor's entire legacy of law. " Chunren said, "Not so. Law itself is not flawed. Where it is flawed, it should be changed. " Zhezong said, "People compare him to Qin Shi Huang and Emperor Wu. " Chunren said, "Su Zhe spoke of policies and their times—not of the man himself. " Zhezong's anger eased a little. Su Zhe often disagreed with Chunren—but now he bowed and thanked him, saying, "You are a man of Buddha's stature. " Su Zhe was still stripped of office and sent to Ruzhou.
68
全台言蘇軾行呂惠卿告詞，訕謗先帝，黜知英州。 純仁上疏曰：「熙甯法度，皆惠卿附會王安石建議，不副先帝愛民求治之意。 至垂簾之際，始用言者，特行貶竄，今已八年矣。 言者多當時御史，何故畏避不即納忠，今乃有是奏，豈非觀望邪？ 」御史來之邵言高士敦任成都鈐轄日不法事，及蘇轍所謫太近。 純仁言：「之邵為成都監司，士敦有犯，自當按發。 轍與政累年，之邵已作御史，亦無糾正，今乃繼有二奏，其情可知。」
The entire censorate charged that Su Shi's draft of Lü Huiqing's farewell rescript slandered the late emperor. He was demoted to prefect of Yingzhou. Chunren memorialized, "The Xining reforms were Lü Huiqing's work, attached to Wang Anshi's proposals. They did not match the late emperor's intent to love the people and govern well. Only after the regency began did the court heed remonstrators and carry out special banishments—and eight years have passed since then. Most of those critics were censors at the time. Why did they hold back and not speak up then? That they submit such a memorial only now—surely they are waiting to see which way the wind blows. " Censor Lai Zhishao reported unlawful conduct by Gao Shidun while he was military controller at Chengdu, and charged that Su Zhe's demotion was too lenient. Chunren said, "Zhishao was the surveillance commissioner at Chengdu. If Shidun had broken the law, Zhishao should have investigated him then. Su Zhe held office for years while Zhishao was already a censor, yet he never corrected him. Now there are two memorials in a row—the motive is plain."
69
純仁凡薦引人材，必以天下公議，其人不知自純仁所出。 或曰：「為宰相，豈可不牢籠天下士，使知出於門下？ 」純仁曰：'但朝廷進用不失正人，何必知出於我邪？ 」哲宗既召章惇為相，純仁堅請去，遂以觀文殿大學士加右正議大夫知潁昌府。 入辭，哲宗曰：「卿不肯為朕留，雖在外，于時政有見，宜悉以聞，毋事形跡。 」徙河南府，又徙陳州。 初，哲宗嘗言：「貶謫之人，殆似永廢。 」純仁前賀曰：「陛下念及此，堯、舜用心也。」
Whenever Chunren recommended talent, he relied on public consensus across the realm. Those he advanced never knew the recommendation came from him. Someone said, "As chancellor, should you not bind scholars across the realm to yourself, so they know they owe their advancement to your patronage? " Chunren replied, "So long as the court appoints upright men, why must they know the recommendation came from me? " After Zhezong summoned Zhang Dun as chancellor, Chunren pressed hard to resign. He was made grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature, with the added title Right Rectifier Grand Master, and prefect of Yingchang. When he came to bid farewell, Zhezong said, "Since you will not stay for me, though you serve in the provinces, report whatever you see of current affairs—do not stand on ceremony. " He was transferred to Henan prefecture, then to Chenzhou. Earlier Zhezong had once said, "Men who are demoted and banished are all but cast aside forever. " Chunren stepped forward to congratulate him: "Your Majesty's concern for this shows the mind of Yao and Shun."
70
既而呂大防等竄嶺表，會明堂肆赦，章惇先期言：「此數十人，當終身勿徙。 」純仁聞而憂憤，欲齋戒上疏申理之。 所親勸以勿為觸怒，萬一遠斥，非高年所宜。 純仁曰：「事至於此，無一人敢言，若上心遂回，所系大矣。 不然，死亦何憾。 」乃疏曰：「大防等年老疾病，不習水土，炎荒非久處之地，又憂虞不測，何以自存。 臣曾與大防等共事，多被排斥，陛下之所親見。 臣之激切，止是仰報聖德。 向來章惇、呂惠卿雖為貶謫，不出裏居。 臣向曾有言，深蒙陛下開納，陛下以一蔡確之故，常軫聖念。 今赴彥若已死貶所，將不止一蔡確矣。 願陛下斷自淵衷，將大防等引赦原放。 」疏奏，忤惇意，詆為同罪，落職知隨州。
Soon Lü Dafang and others were banished to the far south. When a general amnesty was proclaimed at the Bright Hall, Zhang Dun said in advance, "These several dozen men should never be moved for the rest of their lives. " Chunren, hearing this, grew anxious and angry and wished to fast and submit a memorial in their defense. Those close to him urged him not to provoke anger—for at his age, banishment to a distant place would be too much to bear. Chunren said, "Matters have come to this and no one dares speak. If the sovereign's mind is truly turned, what hangs in the balance is enormous. Otherwise, what regret would death hold? " He memorialized, "Dafang and the others are old and ill, unaccustomed to local climates. The hot wastes are no place to dwell long, and they also fear unforeseen danger—how can they survive? Your servant once served with Dafang and the others and was often cast aside—Your Majesty saw this yourself. My urgency is only to repay Your Majesty's sage virtue. In the past, though Zhang Dun and Lü Huiqing were demoted and banished, they were not sent beyond residence in the capital region. Your servant spoke on this before and was deeply received by Your Majesty's openness. Because of one Cai Que, Your Majesty has often shown tender concern. Now Fu Yanruo has died in his place of banishment—it will not stop with one Cai Que. I pray Your Majesty will decide from the depths of your heart and bring Dafang and the others within the amnesty and release them. " When the memorial was submitted, it offended Zhang Dun. Chunren was denounced as sharing their guilt, stripped of office, and made prefect of Suizhou.
71
明年，又貶武安軍節度副使、永州安置。 時疾失明，聞命怡然就道。 或謂近名，純仁曰：「七十之年，兩目俱喪，萬里之行，豈其欲哉？ 但區區之愛君，有懷不盡，若避好名之嫌，則無為善之路矣。 」每戒子弟毋得小有不平，聞諸子怨章惇，純仁必怒止之。 江行赴貶所，舟覆，扶純仁出，衣盡濕。 顧諸子曰：「此豈章惇為之哉？ 」既至永，韓維責均州，其子訴維執政日與司馬光不合，得免行。 純仁之子欲以純仁與光議役法不同為請，純仁曰：「吾用君實薦，以至宰相。 昔同朝論事不合則可，汝輩以為今日之言，則不可也。 有愧心而生者，不若無愧心而死。 」其子乃止。
The next year he was further demoted to military vice commissioner of Wu'an Army and placed under restraint at Yongzhou. By then illness had blinded him. Hearing the order, he set out on the road with equanimity. Some said he sought fame. Chunren said, "At seventy, with both eyes gone—a journey of ten thousand li—is that what I would choose? It is only my slight love for the sovereign, with feelings I cannot fully express. If I shunned the suspicion of seeking fame, there would be no path left for doing good. " He constantly warned his sons and grandsons not to harbor the slightest resentment. When he heard his sons grumbling about Zhang Dun, Chunren always stopped them angrily. Traveling by river to his place of banishment, the boat capsized. They pulled Chunren out, his clothes soaked through. He turned to his sons and said, "Surely Zhang Dun did not cause this? " After reaching Yong, Han Wei was assigned to Junzhou. His son appealed that during Wei's time in power he had disagreed with Sima Guang, and Wei was exempted from going. Chunren's son wanted to appeal on the ground that Chunren and Guang had disagreed on the labor-service law. Chunren said, "It was through Junshi's recommendation that I reached the chancellorship. In the past, when we served together in court, disagreement on policy was acceptable—but you must not use that as grounds for appeal today. Better to die without a guilty conscience than to live with one. " His son then desisted.
72
居三年，徽宗即位，欽聖顯肅後同聽政，即日授純仁光祿卿，分司南京，鄧州居住。 遣中使至永賜茶藥，諭曰：「皇帝在藩邸，太皇太后在宮中，知公先朝言事忠直，今虛相位以待，不知目疾如何，用何人醫之。 」純仁頓首謝。 道除右正議大夫、提舉崇福宮。 不數月，以觀文殿大學士、中太一宮使詔之。 有曰：「豈唯尊德尚齒，昭示寵優； 庶幾鯁論嘉謀，日聞忠告。 」純仁以疾，捧詔而泣曰：「上果用我矣，死有餘責。 」徽宗又遣中使賜茶藥，促入覲，仍宣渴見之意。
After three years, Huizong ascended the throne. Empress Dowager Qinsheng jointly administered affairs with him and that same day appointed Chunren Gentleman of the Bright Hall, with nominal duty at the Southern Capital and residence at Dengzhou. A palace envoy was sent to Yong with tea and medicine, conveying, "When the emperor was still in his princely residence and the Grand Empress Dowager was in the palace, they knew of your loyal and forthright remonstrance in the previous reign. The chancellorship is now left vacant awaiting you. We do not know how your eye ailment is—what physician do you use? " Chunren kowtowed in thanks. En route he was appointed Right Rectifier Grand Master and superintendent of the Palace of Extending Blessings. Within months he was summoned as grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature and director of the Central Grand Unity Palace. The rescript read in part, "Is this not only to honor virtue and respect age, making favor clear to all; but also so that forthright counsel and excellent plans may daily reach the throne? " Chunren, afflicted by illness, received the edict weeping and said, "The sovereign truly means to use me—I could die without failing my charge. " Huizong again sent a palace envoy with tea and medicine, urging him to come to audience and conveying how eagerly the emperor wished to see him.
73
純仁乞歸許養疾，徽宗不得已許之。 每見輔臣問安否，乃曰：「范純仁，得一識面足矣。 」遂遣上醫視疾。 疾小愈，丐以所得冠帔改服色酬醫。 詔賜醫章服，令以冠帔與族侄。 疾革，以宣仁後誣謗未明為恨。 呼諸子口占遺表，命門生李之儀次第之。 其略云：「蓋嘗先天下而憂，期不負聖人之學，此先臣所以教子，而微臣資以事君。 」又云：「惟宣仁之誣謗未明，致保佑之憂勤不顯。 」又云：「未解疆埸之嚴，幾空帑藏之積。 有城必守，得地難耕。 」凡八事。 建中靖國改元之旦，受家人賀。 明日，熟寐而卒。 年七十五。 詔賻白金三十兩，敕許、洛官給其葬，贈開府儀同三司，諡曰忠宣，禦書碑額曰：「世濟忠直之碑」。
Chunren begged leave to return home and convalesce. Huizong reluctantly consented. Whenever he saw chief ministers he asked after Chunren's health and said, "To have met Fan Chunren once is enough. " He then sent the court physician to treat him. When his illness eased somewhat, he asked to repay the physician with the ceremonial cap and sash he had received, altered in rank insignia. An edict granted the physician official robes and ordered that the cap and sash be given to a clansman's nephew. As his illness worsened, he grieved that the slander against Empress Dowager Xuanren had not been cleared. He called his sons to dictate his death memorial and ordered his student Li Zhiyi to put it in order. The gist was, "I once worried ahead of the realm and hoped not to fail the sage's teaching—this is how my late father taught his sons, and how your humble servant was equipped to serve the sovereign. " It also said, "Only because the slander against Xuanren has not been cleared do her protective labors and devoted care remain unrecognized. " And, "The border is still locked in tension, and the treasury has nearly been emptied. Every stronghold must be held, yet land gained is hard to farm. " In all, eight points. On the morning the Jianzhong-Jingguo era name was changed, he received his family's congratulations. The next day he fell into a deep sleep and died. He was seventy-five. An edict granted thirty liang of white silver for funeral expenses and ordered officials of Xu and Lu to provide for the burial. He was posthumously made Grand Preceptor with ceremonial parity to the Three Excellencies. His posthumous title was Loyal and Expansive. The imperial brush wrote the stele heading: "A Stele of Loyal and Upright Service through Generations."
74
純仁性夷易寬簡，不以聲色加人，誼之所在，則挺然不少屈。 自為布衣至宰相，廉儉如一，所得奉賜，皆以廣義莊； 前後任子恩，多先疏族。 沒之日，幼子、五孫猶未官。 嘗曰：「吾平生所學，得之忠恕二字，一生用不盡。 以至立朝事君，接待僚友，親睦宗族，未嘗須臾離此也。 」每戒子弟曰：「人雖至愚，責人則明； 雖有聰明，恕己則昏。 苟能以責人之心責己，恕己之心恕人，不患不至聖賢地位也。 」又戒曰：「《六經》，聖人之事也。 知一字則行一字。 要須'造次顛沛必於是'，則所謂'有為者亦若是'爾。 豈不在人邪？ 」弟純粹在關陝，純仁慮其于西夏有立功意。 與之書曰：「大輅與柴車爭逐，明珠與瓦礫相觸，君子與小人鬥力，中國與外邦校勝負，非唯不可勝，兼亦不足勝，不唯不足勝，雖勝亦非也。 」親族有請教者，純仁曰：「惟儉可以助廉，惟恕可以成德。 」其人書於坐隅。 有文集五十卷，行於世。 子正平、正思。
Chunren's nature was easygoing, generous, and simple. He did not overwhelm others with voice or expression, yet where principle was at stake he stood firm without yielding. From commoner to chancellor he was frugal and self-restrained in the same way. All salary and gifts he received went to his Broad Righteousness estate; when he received the privilege of appointing sons to office, he mostly gave priority to distant kinsmen. At his death his youngest son and five grandsons still held no office. He once said, "What I have learned in life comes down to the two words loyalty and forbearance—a lifetime is not enough to exhaust them. In serving at court, attending the sovereign, receiving colleagues, and honoring kin—I have never for a moment departed from them. " He constantly warned his sons and grandsons, "Even the dullest man is clear-sighted when blaming others; even the cleverest grows dim when forgiving himself. If you can blame yourself with the mind you use to blame others, and forgive others with the mind you use to forgive yourself, you need not fear failing to reach the station of the sages. " He also warned, "The Six Classics are the work of the sages. Understand one word and practice one word. You must hold to them in haste and in distress—then you may say, as the saying goes, 'He who would act must be like this.' Is this not a matter of the person himself? " His younger brother Chun Cui was in Guan and Shan. Chunren feared he harbored ambitions for merit against Western Xia. He wrote him, "When a grand carriage races a hay cart, when a pearl collides with rubble, when a gentleman wrestles strength with a petty man, when the Middle Kingdom contests victory with a foreign state—you cannot win; more than that, it is not worth winning; even if you win, it is still not right. " When kinsmen sought instruction, Chunren said, "Only frugality can help integrity; only forbearance can complete virtue. " The man wrote this at his seat's corner. He had collected writings in fifty scrolls, circulated in the world. His sons were Zhengping and Zhengsi.
75
子正平
Son: Zhengping
76
正平字子夷，學行甚高，雖庸言必援《孝經》、《論語》。 父純仁卒，詔特增遺澤，官其子孫，正平推與幼弟。 紹聖中，為開封尉，有向氏於其墳造慈雲寺。 戶部尚書蔡京以向氏後戚，規欲自結，奏拓四鄰田廬。 民有訴者，正平按視，以為所拓皆民業，不可奪； 民又撾鼓上訴，京坐罰金二十斤，用是蓄恨正平。
Zhengping, styled Ziyi, was of very high learning and conduct. Even in casual speech he would cite the Classic of Filial Piety and the Analects. When his father Chunren died, an edict specially increased the posthumous favor and appointed his sons and grandsons to office. Zhengping yielded the benefit to his younger brother. During Shaosheng he was a captain in Kaifeng. The Xiang clan built the Ciyun Temple at their tomb. Minister of Revenue Cai Jing, because the Xiang were empress consort's kin, schemed to attach himself to them and memorialized to seize neighboring fields and dwellings. When commoners appealed, Zhengping inspected the site and judged all seized land to be private property that could not be taken; the people also beat the appeal drum. Jing was fined twenty jin of gold for this and therefore nursed hatred of Zhengping.
77
及當國，乃言正平矯撰父遺表。 又謂李之儀所述《純仁行狀》，妄載中使蔡克明傳二聖虛佇之意，遂以正平逮之儀、克明同詣御史府。 正平將行，其弟正思曰：「議《行狀》時，兄方營窀穸之事，參預筆削者，正思也，兄何為哉？ 」正平曰：「時相意屬我，且我居長，我不往，兄弟俱將不免，不若身任之。 」遂就獄，捶楚甚苦，皆欲誣服。 獨克明曰：「舊制，凡傳聖語，受本於御前，請寶印出，注籍於內東門。 」使從其家得永州傳宣聖語本有御寶，又驗內東門籍皆同。 其遺表八事，諸子以朝廷大事，防後患，不敢上之，繳申潁昌府印寄軍資庫。 自潁昌取至，亦實。 獄遂解。 正平羈管象州，之儀羈管太平州。 正平家屬死者十余人。
When he came to power, he charged that Zhengping had forged his father's death memorial. He also claimed that Li Zhiyi's narrative biography of Chunren falsely recorded Palace Envoy Cai Keming as conveying the two sovereigns' empty hopes for Chunren's return. Zhengping, Li, and Cai were therefore taken together to the censorate. As Zhengping was about to go, his brother Zhengsi said, "When the narrative biography was drafted, you were busy with the burial. I was the one who helped compose it—why should you go? " Zhengping said, "The chief minister's intent is fixed on me. I am the eldest—if I do not go, both brothers will suffer. Better that I bear it alone. " He entered prison. The beating was severe; all sought forced confessions. Only Keming said, "By old regulation, whenever an imperial message is transmitted, the text is received at the imperial presence, the seal is requested and applied, and the record is entered at the Inner East Gate. " Investigators retrieved from his home the Yongzhou transmission text bearing the imperial seal and verified the Inner East Gate register matched. The eight points of the death memorial—the sons, fearing trouble on weighty state matters, had not submitted them but sealed them with the Yingchang prefecture stamp and deposited them in the army provisions store. When these were fetched from Yingchang, they too proved genuine. The case was then dismissed. Zhengping was placed under restraint at Xiangzhou; Li at Taipingzhou. More than ten of Zhengping's family died.
78
會赦，得歸潁昌。 唐君益為守，表其所居為忠直坊，取所賜「世濟忠直」碑額也。 正平告之曰：「此朝廷所賜，施于金石，揭於墓隧，假寵于范氏子孫則可； 若於通途廣陌中為往來之觀，以聳動庸俗，不可也。 」君益曰：「此有司之事，君家何預焉？ 」正平曰：「先祖先君功名，人所知也。 十室之邑，必有忠信，異時不獨吾家詒笑，君亦受其責矣。 」竟撤去之。 正平退閑久，益工詩，尤長五言，著《荀裏退居編》，以壽終。
When an amnesty came, he was allowed to return to Yingchang. Tang Junyi was prefect there and petitioned to name his residence the Loyal and Upright Ward, taking the granted stele inscription "Loyal and Upright Service through Generations." Zhengping told him, "This was granted by the court—it may be carved in metal and stone, raised at the tomb passage, and used to honor the Fan clan's descendants; but to make it a spectacle for passersby on broad public roads and startle the vulgar—that cannot be done. " Junyi said, "This is the magistrate's affair—what concern is it of your family? " Zhengping said, "The achievements of my ancestors are known to all. In a hamlet of ten households there must be men of loyalty and faith. In time not only our family will be mocked—you too will share the blame. " It was finally removed. After long retirement Zhengping grew more skilled in poetry, especially five-character verse. He authored Records of Quiet Retirement at Xunli and died at a full span of years.
79
論曰：自古一代帝王之興，必有一代名世之臣。 宋有仲淹諸賢，無愧乎此。 仲淹初在制中，遺宰相書，極論天下事，他日為政，盡行其言。 諸葛孔明草廬始見昭烈數語，生平事業備見於是。 豪傑自知之審，類如是乎！ 考其當朝，雖不能久，然先憂後樂之志，海內固已信其有弘毅之器，足任斯責，使究其所欲為，豈讓古人哉！ 」純仁位過其父，而幾有父風。 元祐建議攻熙、豐太急，純仁救蔡確一事，所謂謀國甚遠，當世若從其言，元祐黨錮之禍，不至若是烈也。 仲淹謂諸子，純仁得其忠，純禮得其靜，純粹得其略。 知子孰與父哉！
Commentary: From antiquity, whenever a dynasty arose, there were always ministers of an age. The Song had Zhongyan and such worthies—no shame in this regard. Early in mourning Zhongyan sent a letter to the chancellor exhaustively discussing affairs of the realm. When he later held power, he carried out what he had written. When Zhuge Kongming first met the Founding Emperor from his thatched hut in a few words, his life's enterprise was already fully revealed. Heroes know themselves with such clarity—mostly like this! Consider his time in office: though brief, his resolve to worry first and rejoice after—the realm already believed he had the firm and resolute character to bear such responsibility. Had he been allowed to pursue what he wished, how would he have yielded to the ancients! " Chunren outranked his father and nearly shared his spirit. The Yuanyou proposal to attack the Xining and Feng era reforms too harshly—Chunren's rescue of Cai Que was what is called planning for the state with far sight. Had the age followed his counsel, the Yuanyou faction banishment would not have been so fierce. Zhongyan said of his sons: Chunren inherited his loyalty, Chun Li his composure, Chun Cui his breadth of strategy. Who knows a son better than a father!
